title: Crashes and causes File Explorer to crash
author: ThePensive

judgment.rationale: Maintainers identified two materially newer conditions after the 0.79-era reports: disabled Explorer add-ons are no longer always registered from 0.94 onward, and exception 0x8898008d is associated with graphics/DWM behavior. Current evidence is needed before retaining this as a PowerToys shell-extension crash.
evidence: Original failures involve PowerToys.Settings.exe and explorer.exe in dwmcorei.dll with 0x8898008d.
A maintainer reproduced disabled Explorer extensions remaining loaded in older behavior.
A maintainer states that 0.94 changed registration so disabled File Locksmith, New+, PowerRename, and Image Resizer are not registered.
Graphics-driver and advanced graphics settings are discussed as mitigations.
judgment.recommended_action: Request current stable verification with all Explorer add-ons disabled and a fresh event/report if the same exception persists.

fix_assessment.rationale: The original registration behavior changed and the remaining exception may be outside PowerToys, so an active PowerToys fix is not yet grounded.

issue_context.summary: Older PowerToys versions and Explorer crashed in DWM-related modules; later releases changed disabled shell-extension registration and may remove the PowerToys trigger.
known_information: The issue is labeled reproducible and high priority.
inferences: Some original reports may now be handled, while pure graphics-driver failures may remain.
issue_context.analysis: A current clean-boundary test can determine whether this remains a PowerToys-owned defect.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same exception occurs on current stable with Explorer add-ons disabled.
information_gaps.why_needed: The relevant registration behavior changed in 0.94.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Disable File Locksmith, New+, PowerRename, and Image Resizer, restart, and retest.

information_gaps.information: A fresh event entry and /bugreport if it persists.
information_gaps.why_needed: The module and exception must be compared with the old DWM failures.

actions.label: Request current shell-extension crash verification
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Please retest on the current stable PowerToys release after disabling File Locksmith, New+, PowerRename, and Image Resizer, then restart Windows before testing Explorer and Settings. Version 0.94 changed disabled shell-extension registration, so this boundary matters. If the same crash persists, provide the new Event Viewer faulting module/exception code and submit `/bugreport` immediately afterward.
